_doc: The trailer's edit: shot order, lengths, transitions and the score's sections, in one place.
Each clip is a shot rendered by `make trailer-shot SHOT=<id>` (game/data/trailer/shots.json) or a
card. `dur` is what the cut keeps (s); a shot may be rendered longer and is trimmed from `in`.
`fade_in` / `fade_out` dip to black inside the clip, so lengths add up exactly. Section start
times are checked against the clip lengths by assemble.py and drive tools/trailer/score.py.
`hits` are the score's low impacts (card slams), in seconds from the start.
